usedFor: Robopost plans social posts, and “Create Scheduled Post” queues one for a chosen time.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Scheduled Post” in Robopost
bestTemplate.why: It queues a post from another event, so it goes out without someone opening Robopost.

watchOut: A post is public, so it waits for your approval before “Create Scheduled Post” queues it.
